lines.zh: 我不能走，我被固定在叶上。
lines.en: I can't walk; I'm fixed to the leaf.
I can only sway on a thread.

lines.zh: 风推我一下，我就摆一摆。
lines.en: When the wind pushes, I swing.

lines.zh: 我挂在这儿，动不了地方。
lines.en: I hang here and cannot move elsewhere.
I sway, but I don't leave.
My case clings to the midrib.

lines.zh: 我在风里转了一点角度。
lines.en: I've turned a little in the wind.

lines.zh: 下面的世界在动，我在上。
lines.en: The world below moves; I'm above.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，等时间过去。
lines.en: I stay still and let time pass.
The branch bends and I swing with it.
I'm very secure in this spot.
I'm blown slightly askew.
This leaf shields me from rain.
I swing slowly back.

lines.zh: 我随枝条慢慢侧过一点。
lines.en: I tip slightly as the twig bends.
I rock gently in the leaf's shade.

lines.zh: 我垂在叶下，像一枚绿果。
lines.en: I hang beneath the leaf like a green fruit.
My case has hardened; I'm changing inside.
Inside this shell, it is nearly done.
I quietly await emergence.
An insect crawls over my leaf.

lines.zh: 我的壳在阳光下透着绿。
lines.en: My case shows green in the sun.
I hear birds calling in the tree.
Inside the shell, wings are slowly assembling.
My shape resembles a rolled leaf.
Rain slides off my case.
I feel movement inside.
Time passes slowly for me.
You lean in; I'm under the leaf.
I hang above your line of sight.
Don't touch; I'm almost ready.
I look a bit like a dead leaf, don't I.
Your breath stirs me.

lines.zh: 我看不见你，只感觉到热。
lines.en: I can't see you; I feel the heat.
I've hung here many days.
Will you wait to see me come out?
I'm fragile; don't press.
I suppose you've come to observe me.
My chrysalis is thin enough to pass light.
The me inside drew tight.
Another fine crack appeared.
It swayed a long while; the silk still holds.
My silk still holds.
I try hard not to split.
Don't break me at this stage.
I swayed a few times, then held on.
Only a little time left.
I endure it, unmoving.
A leaf? I don't eat now.
I stopped eating long ago.
I'm changing inside; no need to feed me.
Just set it beside me.
This shell of mine hardens by the hour.
Once out, I'll go for nectar.
I smell it, but I can't move.
You needn't worry about me.
Full inside, still outside.

lines.zh: 把叶子留给别的毛虫吧。
lines.en: Leave the leaf for other caterpillars.
Hanging under the leaf, I'm out of reach.

lines.zh: 你撞到枝条，我晃了很久。
lines.en: You hit the branch and I swung a long while.
A fine crack has appeared on my case.
My silk still holds; it didn't break.
Don't shake the twig; I'd fall.
I'm under the leaf, you're above.
Your hand brushed the leaf edge.
That set me swaying badly.

lines.zh: 叶背的丝被我拉得发紧。
lines.en: The silk on the leaf's underside pulls taut.
I've swung back into place.
Another chrysalis hangs nearby.

lines.zh: 我们两个并排挂在叶下。
lines.en: We hang side by side under the leaf.
It must be changing inside too.
The wind comes and we sway together.

lines.zh: 等我们出来，就是蝴蝶了。
lines.en: When we emerge, we'll be butterflies.

lines.zh: 那时我们会飞同一片林子。
lines.en: Then we'll fly the same wood.
A stretch of stem lies between us.
Quietly, we wait together.
Will it emerge before me?

lines.zh: 这片林子会有更多翅膀。
lines.en: This wood will have more wings.
I can't even move the leaf.

lines.zh: 掉下来的东西落在叶上。
lines.en: Something fell onto the leaf.
I look at it through my case, unclear.
It's just below me.
I'll let the wind blow it away.
It's pressing on one of my threads.
I can't take it; I can only watch.
The rain will wash it away.

lines.zh: 我的位置没有变，森林的枝还挂着。
lines.en: I have not moved; the forest branch still holds me.
None of this concerns me now.
I have nothing to attack.

lines.zh: 我连转个方向都做不到。
lines.en: I cannot even turn to face you.

lines.zh: 你要碰我，我也只能受着。
lines.en: If you touch me, I can only bear it.
My case is hard now.

lines.zh: 这层壳把我锁得死死的。
lines.en: This shell holds me utterly still.

lines.zh: 我只是挂在叶下的一枚蛹。
lines.en: I'm only a chrysalis under a leaf.
Don't pry me open.
I'm not finished inside.
It isn't time yet.

lines.zh: 我的蛹固定在叶上，动不了地方。
lines.en: My chrysalis is fixed to the leaf; I cannot move.
I listen to sounds outside.
Your steps are close to the leaf.
I feel the tremors through the case.
I wait for this to pass.
My silk still holds the twig.
I won't fall and won't run.
The longer it shakes, the quieter I get.
I've drawn myself in a little.
As long as the twig holds.
I count the footsteps outside my shell.
I have no way to attack.
I only swayed.
The case's edge touched your finger.
My weight is almost nothing.
I press tighter inside the case.

lines.zh: 你大概只感觉到一点硬。
lines.en: You'd feel only a bit of hardness.
That's not an attack; only wind.
I've no strength to push anything.
A forest chrysalis, perfectly still.
Let this pass.
I formed this case under the leaf.
My caterpillar days are over.
A green chrysalis hangs on the twig.

lines.zh: 我用几根丝把自己系住了。
lines.en: A few threads hold me fast.

lines.zh: 我选了这个不太显眼的位置。
lines.en: I chose this inconspicuous spot.

lines.zh: 森林里风很大，这里还好。
lines.en: The forest is windy; here it's fine.
I'm slowly hardening.

lines.zh: 我现在不能动，也不需动。
lines.en: I can't move now, and needn't.

lines.zh: 这枚壳会替我保守秘密。
lines.en: This case will keep my secret.
Wait; I'll take another shape.

lines.zh: 热一烘，我的壳开始发脆。
lines.en: The heat makes my case brittle.
I dropped from under the leaf.
Water seeps into my case and I'm stifled.

lines.zh: 爆风把整片叶子掀翻了。
lines.en: The blast flips the whole leaf.

lines.zh: 那支箭穿过了我旁边的叶。
lines.en: The arrow pierced the leaf beside me.

lines.zh: 那道光让我里面乱成一团。
lines.en: The light stirs everything inside me.
I live on what I stored before.
The thunder is loud enough to ring my case.
There's no leaf here to hang from.
